answer: A bounty bond in a crystal registry pays hunters to expose farmed identities. Applicants stake 70 credits, file one orchard claim; auditors hunt shared operators. A sparrow auditor proving two plots share one operator wins a 40-credit bounty; fraud burns the bond. Each fake costs 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. False claims burn the claimant's bond, foiling rented-auditor rings. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep full shares.
